definitions.expectedPoints: ESPN Expected Points means ESPN's stored full-season preseason projection under the LFL's scoring settings. Weekly in-season projections are not summed.
definitions.draftValue: Draft Value Percentile ranks a player's full-season fantasy-point outcome against other LFL picks at the same position and draft round. The player being graded is excluded from the comparison set. It is a relative draft outcome measure, not a fantasy-point projection.
definitions.projection: ESPN preseason full-season projection versus the player's actual full-season fantasy points. Usable archive coverage is 2018-2022 and 2024-2025. 2023 is intentionally excluded because ESPN's historical archive returns corrupted zero projections for most drafted players.
definitions.draftTeamProduction: Actual starter points scored while the player was still on the franchise that drafted him. Bench points and starter points after leaving the drafting franchise do not count.
definitions.classGrades: Draft-class grades are percentile bands of average centered Draft Value Score (Draft Value Percentile minus 50) across all 156 historical LFL classes.

meta.qualityNote: Playoff bracket-bye rows are excluded from weekly production-quality downgrades.

preseasonProjectionUnavailable.2013-2017: ESPN historical archive did not retain usable season-level preseason projections.
preseasonProjectionUnavailable.2023: Excluded because ESPN's historical season-projection row is corrupted for this league: 160 of 192 drafted players return 0.0, including healthy elite players, and the zeros persist across roster snapshots 0-18.
